_comment: Every third-party program the macOS packages ship, per architecture (x64 = Intel, arm64 = Apple silicon). Pinned by version + SHA-256 (checked against each publisher's own digest file on 2026-10-22: hysteria hashes.txt, v2ray/Xray .zip.dgst); scripts/fetch-deps.mjs refuses any mismatch. Same versions as the Windows and Linux apps. WireGuard / wireguard-go / AmneziaWG / OpenVPN come from Homebrew (install-deps.sh), not bundled. Bump = new url + sha256 + a live test.

local.name: dvpnd
local.note: final6.16 11-13 (tag fork-cb33-4-final6.16 = 5b0a398, ctl-1 ~/final-cb33-616, SHA256SUMS 6/6 OK; rc.2): final6.15 + darwin pin.CloseConns after admitNode's pf Apply (the reload dropped the in-flight RPC conn state). Before: final6.15 (7b914d4) = final6.14 + darwin Stop waits (bounded 8 s) for the old utun to go, then closes pinned RPC conns (Agent M: chain reads timed out through the dying wireguard-go utun in a switch). Before: final6.14 (0d8410f) = final6.13 + Q0557 admitNode (a server switch under the kill switch moves the block permit to the new server in one Apply; the block never lifts). Before: final6.13 (6f5ae65) = final6.12 + Q0555 (Mac userspace WireGuard/AmneziaWG: a failed stats read with the tunnel gone (name file / dead UAPI socket) after Wait cannot tell = engine exited, redial). Before: final6.12 (f99ca49) = final6.11 + f99ca49 (doctor: a user kill_switch store failure reads skip, Q0547 part 2). Before: final6.11 (9d21e47) = final6.10 + Q0549 (after an engine crash under kill switch persist dvpnd redials on the data-path probe first instead of ending the session on the stats poller and leaving the user blocked). final6.10 (479f5a3) = final6.9 + Q0547 (non-root doctor reports privileges, key permission denials, the kill_switch store and the macOS background check as severity skip, never ok; sfltool still never run as a normal user) + Windows-only Q0548 SCM reset and OpenVPN minimum 2.6.23. final6.9 (edfea87) = final6.8 + Q0542 (doctor never runs `sfltool dumpbtm` as a normal user: it popped an administrator password dialog behind the Kill switch / Diagnostics screens and hung; 10 s deadline as root; whole doctor run bounded by --timeout, default 60 s). final6.8 (4d776ab) = final6.7 (2e6ea49) + Q0538 pf interface list (kill switch + app split: "utun4,dvpn-c0" rendered as { utun4 dvpn-c0 }, pfctl refused the comma form and the connect failed) + a latent Linux nft fix. devnet ldflags (program J52dyXW3, mint Hen2LVP6), go1.27.3 -trimpath. No vcs stamp (archive build).
